added.description: Add a reaction. One active reaction per sender, target, emoji.

emoji.description: One Unicode extended grapheme cluster, at most 32 UTF-8 bytes, no invisible control characters. The byte limit is enforced by the validator; this schema excludes control characters.

target_event_id.description: Lowercase canonical UUIDv4 of the target event.

removed.description: Remove a reaction. Deactivates the matching prior reaction; never deletes history.
